title: Ark measures, decks, and clean and unclean
english: Concerning Noah’s ark: [[length three hundred cubits, width fifty, height thirty; at the top it is narrowed to a cubit >> Bible:Genesis 6:15-16]]. Three decks. [[Of the clean, sevens; of the unclean, pairs >> Bible:Genesis 7:2]]. Gather foods. [[Noah did all that the Lord commanded him >> Bible:Genesis 6:22]]. The narrow peak suits the rains; the square base stands steady in the waves.
translator_notes: True OET: no Heine FOTC 71 wording.
Homilia II CLOSEOUT after Homilia I 4cfaa156.

title: Apelles’ objection and the geometric cubit
english: Apelles, Marcion’s pupil, objected that so brief a space could not hold so many kinds of animals and a year’s food. The answer: Moses, [[trained in all the wisdom of the Egyptians >> Bible:Acts 7:22]], set a geometric cubit — by the solid cubit’s “power” the spaces enlarge. So the ark could hold the world’s seeds for restoration.
translator_notes: True OET: no Heine FOTC 71 wording.
Homilia II CLOSEOUT after Homilia I 4cfaa156.

title: Ark as church; Noah as Christ the rest-giver
english: Spiritually the ark is the church; Noah is Christ — rest and the just one. Few who live by rational knowledge stand at the summit with Noah; the crowd of the irrational holds the lower places. By steps one comes to Christ. Lamech said, [[This one will give us rest >> Bible:Genesis 5:29]] — fulfilled perfectly in Christ, [[who takes away the sin of the world >> Bible:John 1:29]].
translator_notes: True OET: no Heine FOTC 71 wording.
Homilia II CLOSEOUT after Homilia I 4cfaa156.

title: Raven and dove from the window
english: Noah opens the [[window >> Bible:Genesis 8:6]]. The [[raven goes out and does not return >> Bible:Genesis 8:7]]; the [[dove returns with an olive branch >> Bible:Genesis 8:11]]. The raven is an unclean sense lingering by the world’s corpses; the dove is the Spirit and the simple soul coming back to the church’s ark with the sign of peace.
translator_notes: True OET: no Heine FOTC 71 wording.
Homilia II CLOSEOUT after Homilia I 4cfaa156.

title: Go out of the ark — grades in one church
english: [[Go out of the ark, you and your wife and your sons and your sons’ wives, and all the animals >> Bible:Genesis 8:16-17]]. Diversity in the church: some already gentle, some still wild and to be tamed by faith. [[One baptism >> Bible:Ephesians 4:5]], yet not one and the same progress — [[each in his own order >> Bible:1 Corinthians 15:23]].
translator_notes: True OET: no Heine FOTC 71 wording.
Homilia II CLOSEOUT after Homilia I 4cfaa156.

title: Altar and sweet savor — Homilia II CLOSEOUT
english: [[Noah built an altar to the Lord and offered of the clean animals >> Bible:Genesis 8:20]]. The [[pleasing odor >> Bible:Genesis 8:21]] is Christ’s offering. The blessing: [[Increase and multiply >> Bible:Genesis 9:1]]. This is Homily II’s close — from the ark as far as the altar. Amen.
translator_notes: True OET: no Heine FOTC 71 wording.
Homilia II CLOSEOUT after Homilia I 4cfaa156.
